sample: ORIGINAL_TEN_AMD_2022Q1_TO_2024Q2; seven admitted and three unchanged exclusions
strategy_scope: C legal entry; D retained alongside it; no reexecution of A/B or C/D
entry_scope: Only recorded C BUY at the legal following RTH open. No-entry events remain coverage rows; no invented fills.
horizon_definition: Entry session counts as 1; use the close of session entry_index+horizon-1 within original snapshot AND original score interval. Missing tail is null, never shortened.
range: max(high)/entry_regular_open-1 and min(low)/entry_regular_open-1 over the declared horizon; extrema order unknown, not executable MFE/MAE after stop
costed_valuation: Retained entry cash_after plus retained entry quantity times horizon close; unrealized research mark only. Entry fee and slippage included; no invented exit fee/fill or claimed no-stop backtest.
post_exit_range: Only full sessions strictly after the recorded exit session through the horizon; entry-day remainder and intrabar order stay unknown.
comparisons: Show recorded stop path, entry and exit fees, exit basis, realized PnL/initial cash, and fixed 1/3/5 raw changes plus retained-entry mark estimates. No hypothesis selected by best horizon.
data_rule: Use original admitted raw-unadjusted RTH aggregate snapshots only. Provider K_DAY remains crosscheck; old three OHLC disagreements remain excluded, not zero returns.
stop_conditions: No new prices, company facts, account or model requests
Any input hash, candidate identity or snapshot mismatch stops computation
Unavailable horizon or chronology stays unavailable
Daily intrabar extrema do not establish exact sequence or holding time
No conclusion of edge or exit causality from two correlated AMD events
source_view: Current retained HTML; reviewed in 2026; historical 120s event and 60s bar lag are assumptions
